# Third-party image credits

These images belong to their owners. We keep copies here only for repair research, identification and commentary, so the research page still renders when the originals move or vanish. The folder names are the websites the images came from. Each copy is resized to at most 1200 px wide and re-encoded as WebP. The full-size originals are in the gitignored `../../.cache/evidence/` folder.

If you own one of these images and want it removed, open an issue.

All images retrieved 2026-11-17.
